items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: I got to ask Nancy Wilson about that one time because she was singing with the Clayton band and I had a moment, it was just a gift, I said I want to ask you about it.

ctx.x: Oh I love Nat Adderley. Well one person — it kind of gave it away because I knew it was Cannonball, but I’m a huge, like one of my — that’s cornet — I’m a huge Nat Adderley fan. Oh I love Nat Adderley. You know we talk about our desert island records, the record that Cannonball and Nancy Wilson did.
Oh I can’t believe you said that.
